questions.question: In Executive & State Legislature: PM, CoM, Governor & CM, this exam clue belongs to which area: "Art 74: CoM with PM at head to aid and advise President (advice is BINDING after 42nd/44th Amdts). Art 75: PM appointed by President. Ministers appointed by President on..."?
questions.explanation: PM & Council of Ministers (Art 74 & 75): Art 74: CoM with PM at head to aid and advise President (advice is BINDING after 42nd/44th Amdts). Art 75: PM appointed by President. Ministers appointed by President on PM's advice. Ministers hold office during the PLEASURE of the President. Collective Responsibility : CoM is collectively responsible to the LOK SABHA (not RS).

questions.question: In Executive & State Legislature: PM, CoM, Governor & CM, this exam clue belongs to which area: "Appointed by President. Holds office during the PLEASURE of the President (no fixed tenure/security). Acts as a dual agent : Constitutional head of state + Agent of..."?
questions.explanation: The Governor (Art 153–161): Appointed by President. Holds office during the PLEASURE of the President (no fixed tenure/security). Acts as a dual agent : Constitutional head of state + Agent of Central Govt. Article 163: CoM to advise Governor (Governor's discretionary power is WIDER than President's). Art 161: Pardoning power (excludes death/court-martial).

questions.question: In Executive & State Legislature: PM, CoM, Governor & CM, this exam clue belongs to which area: "CM appointed by Governor. Art 164: State CoM is collectively responsible to the STATE LEGISLATIVE ASSEMBLY (Vidhan Sabha). Similar to the Union, the Governor acts on the..."?
questions.explanation: Chief Minister & State CoM: CM appointed by Governor. Art 164: State CoM is collectively responsible to the STATE LEGISLATIVE ASSEMBLY (Vidhan Sabha). Similar to the Union, the Governor acts on the advice of the State CoM.

questions.question: In Executive & State Legislature: PM, CoM, Governor & CM, this exam clue belongs to which area: "Unicameral (only Vidhan Sabha) or Bicameral (Vidhan Sabha + Vidhan Parishad). Currently only 6 states have Vidhan Parishad: UP, Bihar, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Telangana..."?
questions.explanation: State Legislature: Structure: Unicameral (only Vidhan Sabha) or Bicameral (Vidhan Sabha + Vidhan Parishad). topic_title: Executive & State Legislature: PM, CoM, Governor & CM
lesson_intro: Today we transition from the Union to the States and look at the 'Real Executives'. In India's parliamentary system, the Prime Minister (at the Union) and the Chief Minister (at the States) are the pivots of power. We explore the principle of 'Collective Responsibility'—the idea that the entire Council of Ministers (CoM) sinks or swims together. We also look at the 'Governor' (Art 153), a position that has often been at the center of political storms. For a UPSC aspirant, understanding the parallels and differences between the Union and State executive is the key to mastering Federalism.
